notes.title: V1.03 – Symbiote & New Mob
notes.content: [h3]🧬 Symbiote Redesign[/h3][list][*][p]The Symbiote has received a [b]more advanced and detailed visual overhaul[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Tentacles are now more dynamic, immersive, and visually striking.[/p][/*][/list][h3]⚔️ Symbiote Combat System[/h3][list][*][p]The Symbiote can now [b]launch direct attacks[/b] on enemies and players.[/p][/*][/list][h3]🧠 Symbiote Progression[/h3][list][*][p]The Symbiote can now [b]collect XP orbs[/b] by eliminating:[/p][list][*][p]Mushroom mobs[/p][/*][*][p]Goblin enemies[/p][/*][*][p]Dwarf players[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]When leveling up, symbiote can:[/p][list][*][p][b]Boost a stat[/b] (e.g., speed, tentacle lengths...)[/p][/*][*][p][b]Unlock new abilities[/b][/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h3]🍄 New Creature[/h3][list][*][p]Added a new mob: [b]Mushroom[/b][/p][list][*][p]Features a [b]basic AI[/b] for simple interactions and attacks.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Dwarves can now [b]jump on mushrooms[/b] to perform [b]high bounces[/b] or reach specific areas.[/p][/*][/list]

tags.feature: The Symbiote has received a more advanced and detailed visual overhaul.
Tentacles are now more dynamic, immersive, and visually striking.
The Symbiote can now launch direct attacks on enemies and players.
The Symbiote can now collect XP orbs by eliminating:
Boost a stat (e.g., speed, tentacle lengths...)
Features a basic AI for simple interactions and attacks.
Dwarves can now jump on mushrooms to perform high bounces or reach specific areas.

notes.title: V1.02 - On the right road.
notes.content:
[h2]🆕 New Features[/h2]

[h3]🌊 Lobby :[/h3]
[list]
  [*]Added interactive water points.[/*]
  [*]Added a fishing rod allowing players to fish for gold in the lobby.[/*]
  [*]Possibility to fish a dwarf, causing them to jump a few meters.[/*]
  [*]Added a dedicated jumping area.[/*]
  [*]Added a black screen during lobby loading.[/*]
  [*]Added random events: strange sounds, flickering lights.[/*]
[/list]

[h3]⚔️ Gameplay :[/h3]
[list]
  [*]Added a first mob: Goblin with basic AI.[/*]
  [*]Introduction of 4 fully functional playable classes (Deadly Sins).[/*]
  [*]Added health bars for dwarf players.[/*]
  [*]Added health orbs dropped by goblins.[/*]
  [*]Added particles to interactable objects.[/*]
  [*]Ability to set a time limit per game.[/*]
[/list]

[h3]🖥️ Interface and Settings :[/h3]
[list]
  [*]New interface with settings: Gameplay, Audio, Key Mapping, and Graphics.[/*]
  [*]Added new phrases and tips for the loading screen.[/*]
  [*]Added a score summary screen for each player at the end of the game.[/*]
  [*]Converted game score into gold, usable to buy skins.[/*]
[/list]

[h3]🏆 Steam Integration :[/h3]
  [*]Added Steam achievements.[/*]



[h2]🔨 Bug Fixes[/h2]

[h3]🛠️ Lobby :[/h3]
[list]
  [*]Fixed a major bug where players would lose orientation in the Fighter Lobby.[/*]
  [*]Fixed an arcade machine bug where the game was not synchronized.[/*]
  [*]General lobby improvements for a smoother experience.[/*]
[/list]

[h3]⚙️ Gameplay :[/h3]
[list]
  [*]Fixed a bug where the Symbiote could sprint indefinitely.[/*]
  [*]Complete synchronization of the Symbiote's sprint between server and clients.[/*]
  [*]If the Symbiote falls off the map, it now triggers a game end.[/*]
  [*]Fixed a major bug where dwarf players would move jerkily.[/*]
  [*]Fixed a bug where dwarf sounds were triggered multiple times.[/*]
  [*]Fixed a bug where the player could not crouch with the fishing rod.[/*]
[/list]

[h3]🎭 Classes :[/h3]
[list]
  [*]Improved the invisibility bubble for the Sloth class.[/*]
  [*]Dwarves can now move while casting spells.[/*]
[/list]

[h3]🖥️ Interface :[/h3]
[list]
  [*]Ability to disable Camera Lag in the settings.[/*]
  [*]Restricted nickname length to avoid display bugs.[/*]
[/list]

[h3]🔄 General :[/h3]
[list]
  [*]Players can now properly leave a game or quit the game, then create or join another game.[/*]
  [*]Correct synchronization of game launching for all players.[/*]
  [*]Added a scoring system based on achievements.[/*]
[/list]



[h2]🔊 Audio Improvements[/h2]
[list]
  [*]Added new sounds (temporarily, to be adjusted later).[/*]
[/list]
